result.description: Open-source Python CLI that hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ sites.
result.auth_detail: No hosted API, so no auth. Local CLI only; runs on user's machine. Hosted wrappers (Apify) use Apify tokens, not Sherlock's.
result.access_detail: Sherlock is a MIT-licensed CLI (pipx/pip/docker install). No vendor-hosted REST API or API keys exist. Toolkit would need to run the CLI/library in a sandbox or use third-party hosted wrappers (Apify actors).
result.api_notes: Only CLI: `sherlock user1 user2`, options for output files, proxy, timeout, site filters, --json/--local site data. No network API. Third-party Apify actors expose hosted API (paid Apify account).
result.blocker: No hosted API or credentials; local CLI only. Needs sandbox execution or third-party wrapper; not a standard OAuth/API-key integration.

evidence.quote: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
Accounts found will be stored in an individual text file with the corresponding username (e.g `user123.txt`).
